question:
It's fair to say Regulus was naturally unhinged from the start, right?
Who was the first person to pity him? Who was truly deficient? Who was truly unfulfilled?
Unable to comprehend any of this to the bitter end, Regulus is truly pitiable after all.
answer:
I won't go so far as to say that going through hardship and interacting with people makes your heart strong enough to mature, but if you obtain power from an early age that lets both your mind and body hide inside an absolute shell, there's zero room for growth. Hence his character setting: an ability holder of "Invincibility" who possesses the ultimate tofu mentality.
Yes, he was completely beyond saving from the very beginning.
He was perverse enough that he couldn't even accept his family's kindness at face value, and twisted enough that it curdled into pure hatred. That's all there was to him.
